svg.title: Diffusion forward and reverse
svg.desc: Forward (fixed): add noise to a clean image over steps t = 0 to 1 until pure noise. Reverse (learned): a network removes noise step by step from pure noise to a new image.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Diffusion: destroy structure with fixed noise, learn to undo it
